description_expanded: About Beach Castle: Welcome to "Beach-Castle," your dream vacation rental along the stunning shores of Santa Rosa Beach! This luxurious seven-bedroom Gulf-front home in 30A offers an unparalleled experience for up to 18 guests, ensuring comfort, entertainment, and relaxation throughout your stay. As you step inside this exquisite retreat, you'll immediately be greeted by an atmosphere of luxury and charm. The spacious interior boasts breathtaking ocean views from several bedrooms, allowing you to wake up to the soothing sound of waves crashing against the shore. The living areas are designed for both leisure and entertainment, featuring a ping pong table and a pool table where guests can engage in friendly competitions. For those who prefer to unwind outdoors, the beachfront home's private pool and beach chairs await, providing the perfect setting for soaking up the sun or enjoying a refreshing dip in crystal-clear waters. As evening falls, gather around the outdoor fireplace to roast marshmallows under the starry sky, creating cherished memories with loved ones. Inside, the grand piano sets the stage for elegant soirées and impromptu concerts, adding a touch of sophistication to your vacation experience. This Santa Rosa Beach rental boasts a gourmet kitchen that's a chef's delight, equipped with Viking appliances and ample space for preparing delicious meals. Dine in style at the elegant dining table, which comfortably seats eight guests, or opt for al fresco dining on the spacious balcony, where the gentle ocean breeze provides the perfect backdrop for memorable meals. Located within a private gated community, this exclusive Florida vacation rental offers privacy and security, ensuring a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Whether seeking relaxation by the pool, exhilarating water sports, or simply unwinding on the pristine beaches, this Gulf-front property promises an unforgettable vacation experience. Room Details West Wing -King master bedroom: ocean views, shower/ steam room, jetted tub, double vanity -Bunkroom: two twin bunks, connected Jack-n-Jill bathroom with Shower, double vanity -King Bedroom and crib: connected Jack-n-Jill Bathroom -Office space East Wing -King bedroom: ocean views, full bathroom -King bedroom: ocean views, full bathroom -King bedroom and crib: ocean views, full bathroom -King bedroom and queen pullout sleeper sofa: ocean views, full bathroom -Mudroom: full bathroom -Laundry room Things to Do in or Near Santa Rosa Beach The main attraction in Santa Rosa Beach is, of course, the beautiful beach. Spend your days soaking up the sun, swimming in the clear turquoise waters, or simply strolling along the pristine white sand. It's the perfect place to unwind and enjoy the coastal beauty. Explore the natural wonders of 30A by engaging in outdoor activities. Rent a kayak or paddleboard and explore the nearby coastal dune lakes, or go hiking and biking along the scenic trails. Fishing enthusiasts can cast a line and try their luck in the Gulf of Mexico. Visit Seaside: Take a quick drive to the nearby town of Seaside, known for its unique architecture and vibrant atmosphere. Explore the colorful streets, browse local boutiques and art galleries, and savor delicious food at the various restaurants and food trucks. 30A Restaurants: Santa Rosa Beach is renowned for its culinary scene featuring restaurants for every craving. Whether looking to enjoy fresh seafood, farm-to-table dining experiences, or local delicacies, there's a place to eat in Santa Rosa Beach that fits the bill. Don't miss the chance to try some of the area's seafood shacks for a casual and tasty meal. Live Music: Santa Rosa Beach offers a vibrant music scene, with many venues hosting live performances. Check local listings to see if any concerts or events are happening during your stay. Beach Access: The Beach access for this 30A vacation rental is directly behind the house. It only takes 17 steps to hit the sand! Whether you're seeking relaxation on the beach, outdoor adventures, culinary delights, or cultural experiences, staying at Beach Castle in Santa Rosa Beach offers a perfect blend of coastal beauty and exciting activities! Property Highlights: - Private gated community - Private beach - Gulf views from almost every room - Gulf-front pool - Pool table - Ping-pong table - Complimentary wine Property Rules: *Maximum occupancy of this home is 18 guests. *Complimentary 4 beach chairs and 2 umbrellas is offered between March 1st - October 31st *Designated parking is assigned for five moderately sized vehicles in the driveway *There is no smoking inside or outside while on the property. *Pets are not allowed. *Minimum Age Requirement is 25. *Guest must agree to sign the Paradise30A rental agreement within 48 hours of booking, or we will cancel the reservation. *All reservations are non-refundable, we strongly encourage adding travel insurance to your reservation so that you are covered. *Property management is not liable for any construction that may occur outside of the properties we manage. About Paradise Properties: Staying at a Paradise Properties vacation rental means you'll receive more than a typical hotel experience. In fact, all of our Florida properties along the Emerald Coast are professionally cleaned, maintained, and inspected at the highest level. Our inventory features over 100 unique rental options in 30A and beyond, so you'll have access to exceptional amenities with the classic comforts of home. Our 24/7 on-call property management team is here to cater to your needs and make your Florida beach vacation one you'll never forget. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.
